title: Catalog interchange v1 (JSON Lines record)
description: Validates ONE line of a catalog-v1 JSON Lines file. A file is: line 1 a manifest, then every board, then every route. Cross-line rules (record order, referenced board_id and provider_hold_id must exist, uniqueness, content_sha256 over the canonicalised non-manifest lines) are specified in contracts/catalog/README.md and enforced by test/contracts/catalog.test.cjs and the importer (BC-0105).

providerRouteUuid.$comment: No colon and no whitespace: the public route variant id is <provider_route_uuid>:<angle_deg> (ADR-0002, OpenAPI route_variant_id pattern ^[^:\s]{1,64}:-?[0-9]{1,3}$).

manifest.$comment: synthetic=true if and only if license_review_status=SYNTHETIC (encoded by the if/then/else below). The importer refuses synthetic=false unless license_review_status=LOCAL_RESEARCH_ONLY and --acknowledge-audit is passed; the CI guard scripts/ci/check-no-licensed-data.sh refuses any tracked *.jsonl whose first line is not a manifest with synthetic=true.

source.description: Producer / provenance source, e.g. synthetic-demo or kilter. Stored in provenance_sources.source.

version.description: Producer-defined dataset version, e.g. demo-board-v1. Stored in provenance_sources.version.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of every line after the manifest, each line serialised as RFC 8785 canonical JSON and joined with a single LF, no trailing LF. See README.

synthetic.description: Must equal the manifest's synthetic flag (cross-line rule). Stored in boards.synthetic.

geometry.description: Coordinate frame for holds[].x/y; mirrors OpenAPI BoardGeometry. Stored in boards.geometry_json.

y_axis.description: UP means y grows towards the top of the board.

available_angles.description: Angles this board can be set to; every route variant angle_deg must be one of them. Stored in boards.available_angles_json.

provider_hold_id.description: Unique within the board (holds UNIQUE (board_id, provider_hold_id)).

x.description: In geometry.units; the importer stores numeric(8,3), so producers should round to at most 3 decimals.

geometry_meta.description: Free-form producer metadata (e.g. grid row/col). Stored in holds.geometry_meta_json.

board_id.description: Must name a board line earlier in the same file.

setter_pseudonym.description: Never a real account name; producers pseudonymise before export.

placements.description: Shared by every variant of the route in v1 (per-angle placement differences are not representable yet; the importer copies these onto each route_variants row).

provider_hold_id.description: Must exist in the referenced board's holds.

angle_deg.description: Unique within the route; must be in the board's available_angles.

grade_numeric.description: Difficulty on the numeric grade axis (contracts/catalog/grade-scale.v1.json); null when ungraded. Stored as numeric(5,2).
